name: mean
result_en: Arithmetic mean; at least one finite sample.
result_ja: 算術平均。有限値を1個以上。

name: variance
result_en: Sample variance with denominator N−1; at least two samples.
result_ja: 標本分散。分母N−1、2要素以上。

name: stddev
result_en: Sample standard deviation with denominator N−1; at least two samples.
result_ja: 標本標準偏差。分母N−1、2要素以上。

name: population_variance
result_en: Population variance with denominator N; at least one sample.
result_ja: 母分散。分母N、1要素以上。

name: population_stddev
result_en: Population standard deviation with denominator N; at least one sample.
result_ja: 母標準偏差。分母N、1要素以上。

name: covariance
inputs_en: A: X waveform; B: Y waveform
result_en: Sample covariance (N−1); equal lengths of at least two.
result_ja: 標本共分散（N−1）。同じ長さで2要素以上。

name: correlation
inputs_en: A: X waveform; B: Y waveform
result_en: Pearson correlation; equal lengths of at least two, neither constant.
result_ja: ピアソン相関。同じ長さで2要素以上、どちらも定数列不可。

name: weighted_mean
inputs_en: A: data waveform; B: weight waveform
inputs_ja: A: データ波形、B: 重み波形
result_en: Weighted mean. Equal nonempty lengths; weights nonnegative and at least one positive.
result_ja: 加重平均。同じ長さで空不可。重みは非負で1個以上が正。

name: quantile_sorted
inputs_ja: A: 昇順の波形、B: 割合
result_en: Interpolated quantile; fraction is in [0, 1]. Samples must be finite and ascending; interpolation is linear between adjacent values.
result_ja: 補間した分位点。割合は0〜1、サンプルは有限かつ昇順。隣接する値の間を線形補間。

name: vector_norm
result_en: Euclidean norm.
result_ja: ユークリッドノルム。

name: erf
result_en: Error function.
result_ja: 誤差関数。

name: gamma
result_en: Gamma function; excludes non-positive integer poles.
result_ja: ガンマ関数。0以下の整数の極は不可。

name: log1p
result_en: Natural logarithm of 1 + A; A must be greater than −1.
result_ja: 1 + A の自然対数。Aは−1より大きい必要あり。

name: normal_cdf
result_en: Standard normal lower-tail probability.
result_ja: 標準正規分布の下側累積確率。

name: pow_int
result_en: Integer power; zero with a negative exponent is invalid.
result_ja: 整数乗。底が0で指数が負の場合は無効。
args_en: ARGA: integer exponent from −1024 to 1024; blank defaults to 2.

name: polynomial_eval
inputs_ja: A: 係数波形、B: 評価点
result_en: Polynomial value; coefficients in ascending powers.
result_ja: 多項式の値。係数は定数項から昇べき順。

name: interp_linear
inputs_en: A: X waveform; B: Y waveform; C: query
inputs_ja: A: X波形、B: Y波形、C: 評価点
result_en: Linear interpolation; X and Y have equal lengths of at least two, X is strictly increasing, and the query is inside the closed X range.
result_ja: 線形補間。XとYは同じ長さで2点以上、Xは狭義単調増加、評価点はXの範囲内（端を含む）。

name: interp_cspline
inputs_en: A: X waveform; B: Y waveform; C: query
inputs_ja: A: X波形、B: Y波形、C: 評価点
result_en: Natural cubic spline with zero second derivatives at the endpoints; equal lengths of at least three, strictly increasing X, and an in-range query.
result_ja: 端点の2階微分が0の自然三次スプライン。同じ長さで3点以上、Xは狭義単調増加、評価点は範囲内。

name: polynomial_integral
inputs_en: A: coefficients; B: lower bound; C: upper bound
inputs_ja: A: 係数波形、B: 下限、C: 上限
result_en: Definite integral of 1–64 coefficients in ascending powers. Bounds may be equal or reversed; no error estimate is returned.
result_ja: 昇べき順の係数1〜64個の定積分。積分範囲は同値・逆順も可能。誤差推定値は返さない。

name: polynomial_root
inputs_en: A: coefficients; B: lower bound; C: upper bound
inputs_ja: A: 係数波形、B: 下限、C: 上限
result_en: A bracketed root of a polynomial with 2–64 coefficients in ascending powers. Bounds increase and endpoint values have opposite signs unless an endpoint is a root.
result_ja: 昇べき順の係数2〜64個の多項式の根。境界は増加順で、端点が根の場合を除き両端の関数値の符号が異なること。

name: matrix_determinant
inputs_ja: A: 行優先の行列波形、B: 次元
result_en: Determinant. Dimension 1–1024; A has dimension squared elements.
result_ja: 行列式。次元は1〜1024、Aは次元の二乗個。

name: array_scale
result_en: Scaled waveform.
result_ja: 倍率を掛けた波形。
args_en: ARGA: finite factor; blank defaults to 1.

name: moving_mean
result_en: Same-length centered moving mean; endpoints are padded by repeating the first or last sample.
result_ja: 入力と同じ長さの中心移動平均。端では先頭・末尾値を反復して補完。
args_en: ARGA: odd window width 3–4095, no greater than input length; blank uses WIN (default 3).
args_ja: ARGA：3〜4095の奇数窓幅。入力要素数以下。空欄はWIN（既定3）。

name: moving_median
result_en: Same-length centered moving median; endpoints are padded by repeating the first or last sample.
result_ja: 入力と同じ長さの中心移動中央値。端では先頭・末尾値を反復して補完。
args_en: ARGA: odd window width 3–4095, no greater than input length; blank uses WIN (default 3).
args_ja: ARGA：3〜4095の奇数窓幅。入力要素数以下。空欄はWIN（既定3）。

name: gaussian_smooth
result_en: Same-length Gaussian-smoothed waveform. The centered window repeats endpoint values; sigma is (K−1)/(2×alpha) samples.
result_ja: 入力と同じ長さのガウス平滑化波形。中心窓の端は端点値を反復し、標準偏差は(K−1)/(2×alpha)サンプル。
args_en: ARGA: odd window width 3–4095, no greater than input length; ARGB: alpha 0.01–10. Blanks use WIN (default 3) and ALPH (default 1.1774100225154747).
args_ja: ARGA：3〜4095の奇数窓幅（入力要素数以下）。ARGB：alpha 0.01〜10。空欄はWIN（既定3）、ALPH（既定1.1774100225154747）。

name: histogram_uniform
result_en: Bin counts; lower bound is included and upper bound is excluded.
result_ja: ビンごとの個数。下限を含み上限を含みません。
args_en: ARGA: lower bound; ARGB: upper bound; ARGC: bin count 1–65536. Blanks use HMIN=0, HMAX=1 and NBIN=10.

name: linear_fit
inputs_en: A: X waveform; B: Y waveform
result_en: Six DOUBLE values [intercept, slope, cov00, cov01, cov11, residual sum of squares]. X and Y must have equal lengths of at least three; X must not be constant.
result_ja: DOUBLEの6要素［切片、傾き、cov00、cov01、cov11、残差平方和］。XとYは同じ長さで3点以上、Xは定数列不可。

name: fft_real_radix2_forward
result_en: Full complex spectrum as interleaved real and imaginary values; N must be a power of two and OMAX at least 2N.
result_ja: 実部・虚部を交互に並べた全複素スペクトル。Nは2の累乗、OMAXは2N以上。

name: fft_real_radix2_inverse
inputs_ja: A: 共役対称の複素スペクトル
result_en: Real inverse; complex length is a power of two, normalized by 1/N.
result_ja: 実数逆変換。複素数の個数は2の累乗、1/Nで正規化。

name: fft_complex_radix2_forward
inputs_ja: A: 実部・虚部交互の複素波形
result_en: Complex forward FFT; complex length is a power of two.
result_ja: 複素正変換。複素数の個数は2の累乗。

name: fft_complex_radix2_inverse
inputs_ja: A: 実部・虚部交互の複素波形
result_en: Complex inverse FFT; power-of-two length, normalized by 1/N.
result_ja: 複素逆変換。個数は2の累乗、1/Nで正規化。

name: fft_complex_mixed_forward
inputs_ja: A: 実部・虚部交互の複素波形
result_en: Mixed-radix complex forward FFT; any positive complex length.
result_ja: 混合基数の複素正変換。複素数の個数は任意の正数。

name: fft_complex_mixed_inverse
inputs_ja: A: 実部・虚部交互の複素波形
result_en: Mixed-radix inverse FFT; positive complex length, normalized by 1/N.
result_ja: 混合基数の複素逆変換。正の個数、1/Nで正規化。

name: fft_frequency_axis
inputs_en: A: sample count; B: sample interval
inputs_ja: A: サンプル数、B: サンプル間隔
result_en: N signed frequency-bin centers in Hz, in natural FFT order. N is a positive integer and the sample interval is positive; for even N the Nyquist bin is negative.
result_ja: FFTの自然順で並ぶN個の符号付き周波数（Hz）。Nは正の整数、間隔は正。Nが偶数ならナイキスト成分は負側。

name: window_hann
result_en: Symmetric Hann-windowed waveform; a single sample is unchanged.
result_ja: 対称Hann窓を適用した波形。1要素は変更なし。

name: spectrum_power
inputs_ja: A: 実部・虚部交互の複素スペクトル
result_en: Squared magnitude per bin; no normalization.
result_ja: 各ビンの振幅二乗。正規化なし。

name: welch_psd
inputs_en: A: waveform; B: segment length; C: overlap; D: sample interval
inputs_ja: A: 波形、B: 区間長、C: 重なり、D: サンプル間隔
result_en: One-sided PSD with N/2+1 bins. N must be a power of two at least 4, overlap is an integer in [0, N), sample interval is positive, and at least N samples are required.
result_ja: N/2+1要素の片側PSD。Nは4以上の2の累乗、重なりは0以上N未満の整数、サンプル間隔は正、入力はN個以上。

name: stft_hann
inputs_en: A: waveform; B: frame length; C: hop
inputs_ja: A: 波形、B: フレーム長、C: ホップ幅
result_en: Flattened complex frames: N is a power of two at least 4, hop is an integer in [1, N], and output capacity is at least 2N×(1 + floor((sample_count−N)/hop)).
result_ja: 複素フレームを順番に並べた配列。Nは4以上の2の累乗、ホップ幅は1〜Nの整数。出力容量は2N×(1 + floor((サンプル数−N)/ホップ幅))以上。

name: matrix_eigenvalues_symmetric
inputs_en: A: row-major symmetric matrix; B: dimension
inputs_ja: A: 行優先の対称行列、B: 次元
result_en: Ascending real eigenvalues; dimension is an integer 1–1024 and A must be an exactly symmetric row-major matrix with dimension squared finite elements.
result_ja: 昇順の実固有値。次元は1〜1024の整数、Aは次元の二乗個の有限値を持つ行優先の厳密な対称行列。

name: minmax
result_en: Minimum and maximum in separate outputs; not a numericScalar operation.
result_ja: 最小値と最大値を別々に出力。numericScalarでは使用不可。

name: running_mean
inputs_en: aSub: A sample, B sequence number, C reset token; native registry: one scalar sample
inputs_ja: aSubはAがサンプル、Bが連番、Cがリセットトークン。ネイティブはスカラーサンプル1個
result_en: Stateful mean and accepted sample count; state belongs to an instance.
result_ja: 逐次平均と受け付けたサンプル数。状態はインスタンス単位。

name: running_stats
inputs_en: aSub: A sample, B sequence number, C reset token; native registry: one scalar sample
inputs_ja: aSubはAがサンプル、Bが連番、Cがリセットトークン。ネイティブはスカラーサンプル1個
result_en: Mean, sample variance, sample standard deviation, RMS, minimum, maximum and count; variance and standard deviation are NaN after the first sample.
result_ja: 平均、標本分散、標本標準偏差、RMS、最小、最大、個数。最初のサンプルでは分散と標準偏差はNaN。
